reviews.text: thanks Emanuela!!!
Super kind and efficient. We had her spayed and her stomach fixed, and our dog recovered immediately. Truly fantastic. Thanks again ❤️❤️❤️
Thanks Massimo!

I've never encountered such professionalism combined with true love for animals in a veterinary practice. Our 13-year-old kitten, Trilli, arrived in hypovolemic shock and anoxia (ventilated with an Ambulance by our daughter on the way from another practice). She was literally resuscitated with the utmost professionalism and perseverance. They fought with her for several days, successfully completing this impossible feat. Congratulations to the entire staff!

We entrusted our Anastasia to you in the final days of her life, initially with the hope of being able to bring her home. You were exceptional in every aspect of these days, right up to the very end. Thank you for trying, despite everything.

I've been bringing my furry friends to this facility for years now, and I've always had a great experience. Everyone is helpful, kind, and professional. And, well, we're especially fond of one exceptional doctor, but that's another story! 😅
Very helpful and patient! Thank you for your professionalism and patience with my big cat!

I can only thank all the doctors, assistants, and administrative staff for their availability and compassion.
A special thanks goes to Dr. Stefano Cambi, who has earned my utmost respect and gratitude.
Thank you so much! 🙏🏻 …
exceptional behavior with animals, available to take care of them, but perhaps a little too attached to the final invoice

Every time I bring my cat, Blacky, to Appia24, I feel welcomed and taken seriously. The staff is kind and attentive, and they know how to listen and explain things patiently. I truly felt understood and more at ease, knowing that my cat is always treated with care and respect. The doctor was clear and understanding, explaining everything to me with patience and kindness. When I left, I felt more at peace, knowing that my cat was in good hands.
Thanks Elvira!

We arrived at night after hours of vomiting (the only clinic that answered my phone: when you're feeling anxious, hearing a friendly voice is a real relief). My dog ​​was incredibly scared. We were greeted by a very sweet nurse and doctor: both very professional, competent, and fantastic with my dog. A very positive experience, thank you!

I waited a while to write this review because, having my own practice, I'm not in the habit of writing negative reviews, knowing how much they can carry weight. Unfortunately, my experience at this clinic was truly—I can't find any other words—demeaning. I brought my elderly cat with severe kidney failure because she had been eating very little for two days, vomiting, and clearly dehydrated. I informed the person who examined her, a very young woman who was afraid of being scratched while taking her temperature, that I wouldn't admit my cat because I'm already administering subcutaneous therapy to hydrate her and a gastroprotective medication, and that I was there to see if it was appropriate to help her with an antiemetic and a tonic. The lady (I don't feel comfortable calling her a doctor because she's never declared herself one and because her name isn't on the prescription I received) immediately advised me to be admitted urgently. Then, when I refused, she asked me if I still wanted to have a blood gas test, and of course, I agreed, believing it was appropriate to check her blood levels. Three people held her for the blood test. I repeat, three people to hold a debilitated 18-year-old cat who had been covered in a blanket. After the blood test, they took her to another room. The lady came back and asked me if I wanted to have the cat undergo a full-body X-ray because, you know, maybe he has arthritis. As she was about to quote me the cost, I refused. The lady replied, "Sure, whatever you want, you want to save money," and I replied, "It's not primarily about saving money, but about the cat! (I mean, not stressing him out!)." From that point on, the visit was practically over. The cat is returned to me, I'm given the results of the exam, and then, "since you want to do everything at home," I'm prescribed an antiemetic and a skin gel to restore her appetite. I say, "Excuse me, but aren't you going to do anything for her?" And the response, "Oh, but don't you want to take care of everything yourself?" leaves me speechless. I must have been taught the wrong thing, but my trusted veterinarian, who unfortunately is on vacation, won't give me back a suffering animal without at least providing first aid. At my request, the lady finally administered two injections of an antiemetic and vitamins. Now, I'm not shocked to find myself faced with people who are clearly trainees and who gave me a prescription not in their name. I'm shocked because these trainees are trained not to provide treatment but, above all, to make people like me spend as much money as possible, those who find themselves in a moment of vulnerability because their furry friend is in need. What a wonderful generation of professionals you're raising! I should add that the cat, who previously had only a little stiffness, has been limping since yesterday. Never again.
Thanks Gianna!

Hi Giada,
Thank you so much 🙏🏻 …

We were immediately greeted with kindness and helpfulness.
Professionalism and empathy were the qualities we appreciated.
Thank you for everything.
Thanks Ilaria!

I brought my cat because she was experiencing respiratory distress, and they kept her under observation for three days. When they returned her to me, she was stable, and I was referred to a cardiologist. I felt very comfortable, and the doctor who treated my Binky was caring and kind.
Thanks Laura!

Competent and highly trained staff!
They made my old lady's fear of the vet go away! A special thanks to Valeria, she's amazing!

I brought my Margot... she had a strange cough (a pinch-wawa strain), and she was immediately examined and welcomed very well.
They did an ultrasound and tests, and they put a fashionable leopard-print headband on her.
Truly professionals, luckily it was only mild tracheitis, which can be resolved with a syrup!
Doctor and staff: 10+. Margot and I thank you ❤️

On Thursday the 16th at 9:00 PM, we went to this facility, clearly in a state of distress. Our cat had a wound on her neck, bleeding profusely, and we didn't know what else was wrong.
We were told that the only doctor present was busy, and the wait would be at least two hours. We went to another facility worthy of the name 24-hour service. Fortunately, the cat is doing well; the photos are from today, Sunday, July 19th.

I thought a lot about whether to write this review or not, but after months I thought it was right to inform other people and potential future patients of what happened. In March 2025, I took my 15-year-old dog Molly to the clinic for an open wound (her hair had fallen out, and raw skin was visible), and after an examination, I was told it was an old wound. I was prescribed a course of treatment, a week of antibiotics, and to return every so often for checkups with the doctor who had seen us that Saturday afternoon. I began to apply all the necessary medications, but I noticed that the surrounding area was starting to lose hair in clumps, despite my frequent checkups with the doctor, who confirmed that "the wound is fine and healing." Meanwhile, my dog ​​began to complain, to have pain at night, and her hair continued to fall out, all crusted over due to a gel the doctor had told me to apply, which was extremely greasy and heavy. One day I took my dog ​​to another vet because I realized something was wrong, and I was right: the wound wasn't healing at all; in fact, what was above it was dead tissue that was causing the entire area to die. Needless to say, I had to start over with new treatments, new medications, and spend a lot more money to repair the "damage." I don't understand why during checkups I was told that the situation was good and that the wound was recovering... well, the situation was the opposite. Now my dog ​​is no longer with us, not because of this episode, I think it's fair to emphasize. But I will never forget the stress she went through during the recovery phase: loads of antibiotics to make up for a poorly and superficially performed assessment, dressing after dressing... it was definitely a huge blow.
Based on my experience, go elsewhere. Because if I hadn't intervened, I would have just continued to be told that "everything was fine" while my dog ​​was suffering.

Courteous staff with immediate empathy for both humans and furry friends. Qualified veterinarians guide you through your pet's therapeutic journey with professionalism and extraordinary availability. Truly skilled, kind, clear, and, when necessary, even friendly. Hats off to all the staff.
Hi Dario, thanks so much for your feedback! We hope to see you soon.

Despite everything, I'd still like to thank you for the professionalism, availability, and humanity you've shown over the past few days.
A special thanks goes to Stefano for his tact, empathy, and sensitivity... they truly made a difference. You can tell when someone does this job out of true passion and not just duty, and finding such humanity today is not a given.
Thank you for doing everything you could for Mati and for caring for her with the utmost respect until the very end.

Nicoletta

Hello, the first time I go to this veterinary clinic I was amazed by the care and professionalism and heart that all the doctors put into treating and trying to save your four-legged friends, they really do it with all their heart.

Always reliable, friendly, and humane, as well as professional and knowledgeable.

I take care of my pug with them and have always received help with everything.

There are no words to describe the pain of losing a life partner, but during these terrible days, we found support in your clinic that went far beyond the merely professional.

I want to heartily thank Dr. Stefano for exploring every possible avenue, for his expertise, and for never giving up on finding a solution. Thank you to Drs. Noemi, Anna, Sharon, and Francesca Grasso: your kindness, your commitment, and the way you cared for Ares when I couldn't be there made all the difference.

A special and deeply felt thank you goes to Dr. Azzurra. Your sensitivity, your humanity, and the serenity with which you accompanied Ares in his final journey made this moment, as heartbreaking as it was, an act of pure love. Thank you for managing his end with a kindness I will never forget; you allowed me to accompany him in the most dignified way possible.

Thank you to all the staff for your patience, transparency, and for working with us through every difficult decision, always in Ares's best interests. We will not forget you.
